coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run or drawn rule: its x extent, from 14 pt above the line to 1.5 pt under it. Cell or box: its drawn edges. Tick box: the printed square. Picture pages: the picture's pixels through the page's drawing matrix.

signing.kind: Fund share subscription agreement printed as pictures (every odd page a picture, every even page blank): the investor completes sections 1 to 6 (pages 1-17), initials the representations in a primary column with a co-investor column beside it (pages 21-33), and signs on page 33 with the co-investor or custodian beside; the investor representative completes section 7 (page 17) and the financial advisor and branch manager sign on page 19; the custodian stamps on page 5. No issuer acceptance block.

sure_per_page.5: sure; the custodian stamp frame is recorded as the custodian's signature place

sure_per_page.11: sure; the percentage blanks after Primary and Secondary were added by hand
sure_per_page.33: sure; the second signature is co-investor or custodian
sure_per_page.37: unsure whether the document squares are tick boxes or list bullets; kept as tick boxes with a doubt
